---
title: "PVJ"
---
```{r}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

music <- read_csv("MUSIC.csv")

month_order <- c("July", "August", "September", "October")

music <- music %>%
  mutate(
    Month = factor(Month, levels = month_order),
    Rank = as.integer(Rank)
  )


genre_summary <- music %>%
  count(Month, `Primary Genre`, name = "song_count") %>%
  group_by(Month) %>%
  mutate(
    song_share = song_count / sum(song_count)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

print(genre_summary)


music1<- ggplot(
  genre_summary,
  aes(x = Month, y = song_count, fill = `Primary Genre`)
) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "How My Top 10 Music Genres Changed",
    subtitle = "Genre composition of my monthly Top 10 songs",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Number of songs in Top 10",
    fill = "Primary genre",
    caption = paste(
      "Source: Personal QQ Music data.",
      "Counts represent Top 10 entries, not total plays."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

print(music1)


```
